note: City of Falls City park on West 25th Street at the NW edge of town, next to the Itha-Krumme Arboretum: a small fishing lake with a walking trail, disc golf, dog park and playground. An active rail line runs along the west side. --Claude
summary: City parks page confirms 11 full-hookup sites (30/50 A), a bath house, $30 a day ($5 tents), and booking by phone or online. The city's RecDesk portal lists 11 bookable sites: 8 back-in, 3 pull-through. Waterfront lakeview -> not waterfront: the lake is ~4.6 acres on imagery, under the 5-acre line, and the pads sit 100-200 m east behind trees and the shelter. Pin OK (~120 m). The phone is confirmed. Cleared max_rig 37 (reviewers' rigs), dump (not on the city's list) and fcfs 'never' (unstated).
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview -> not waterfront: Stanton Lake measures ~96 x 245 m on imagery, ~18,700 m2 = 4.6 acres by pixel count (three thresholds 4.58-4.67), so under the ~5-acre pond line, and there is no pond-view. The RV area is the paved strip and the gravel lanes east and southeast of the pond, 100-200 m from its east shore, with the walking path, a tree line and the shelter in between.

PIN OK (~120 m): stored 40.07005,-95.61345 is on the pond's SE shore by the shelter; the RV pads (paved strip with pedestals along its east edge, plus the gravel lanes SE) are around 40.0702,-95.6125. A move there is optional.
